# routeur_moderation_rule (Resource)

An output-moderation rule: scans model responses in a workspace and logs, redacts, rewrites or blocks matches. Requires a routeur.ai plan with output moderation to create or change rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "routeur_workspace" "payments" {
  slug = "payments"
  name = "Payments"
}

# A managed category.
resource "routeur_moderation_rule" "profanity" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.payments.id
  name         = "Profanity"
  slug         = "profanity"
  category     = "profanity"
  action       = "redact"
  severity     = "low"
}

# A custom pattern, scoped to one project and scanned as tokens stream.
resource "routeur_project" "checkout" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.payments.id
  slug         = "checkout"
  name         = "Checkout"
}

resource "routeur_moderation_rule" "card_numbers" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.payments.id
  project_id   = routeur_project.checkout.id
  name         = "Card numbers"
  slug         = "card_numbers"
  category     = "regex"
  pattern      = "\\b\\d{16}\\b"
  action       = "block"
  severity     = "high"
  streaming    = "chunked"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) What to do on a match: `log`, `redact`, `block` or `rewrite`.
- `category` (String) What to detect: a managed category (`hate`, `harassment`, `profanity`, `sexual`, `sexual_minors`, `self_harm`, `violence`, `weapons`) or `regex` for a custom `pattern`.
- `name` (String) Display name, 1–80 characters, unique among the workspace's moderation rules.
- `severity` (String) Severity recorded with a match: `low`, `medium` or `high`.
- `slug` (String) The rule's identity in traces: lowercase letters and digits joined by single underscores, at most 64 characters, unique among the workspace's moderation rules. Changing it renames the rule in traces.
- `workspace_id` (String) Id of the workspace this belongs to (`ws_…`), e.g. `routeur_workspace.example.id`. The `routeur_workspace` data source resolves a slug to its id. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enforced. Defaults to `true`; removing the argument enables the rule again.
- `pattern` (String) RE2 regular expression (lookarounds and backreferences are refused), at most 2000 characters. Required when `category` is `regex` and must be omitted for every other category.
- `project_id` (String) Id of a project in the workspace (`proj_…`) to scope the rule to. Omit to apply it to every project in the workspace.
- `streaming` (String) Per-rule override of the organisation's streaming default (see `routeur_moderation_settings`): `buffered` or `chunked`. Omit to inherit the organisation default.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) Public id of the rule (`mod_…`).
- `updated_at` (String) When it was last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# id: <workspace_id>/<rule_id>
import {
  to = routeur_moderation_rule.profanity
  id = "ws_3/mod_7"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <workspace_id>/<rule_id>
terraform import routeur_moderation_rule.profanity ws_3/mod_7
```
